text:
Jamal: quick proposal — thinking about adding "micro_holdpoints" to canary schedules. tiny hold windows between steps that can be skipped or extended based on cohort priority. want feedback on API shape and console UX. TL;DR: percent ramps + decaying priority weights + a surge_threshold to auto-pause. :thinking:

Maria: can you paste a sample config so we can review shape + validation rules?

Jamal: sure, sketch below (pseudo-config we can iterate on):
```json
{
  "model": "v2.1.0",
  "strategy": "percent_ramp",
  "steps": [
    { "target_pct": 1, "duration_s": 600, "micro_hold": true, "hold_max_s": 120, "priority_weights": {"internal": 0.3, "prod": 1.0} },
    { "target_pct": 5, "duration_s": 1800, "micro_hold": true, "attenuate": 0.5, "hold_max_s": 300, "priority_weights": {"internal": 0.2, "prod": 1.0} },
    { "target_pct": 20, "duration_s": 3600, "micro_hold": false }
  ],
  "surge_threshold_pct": 4,         
  "soft_capacity_limit_pct": 90,
  "telemetry_sample_rate": 0.01
}
```

Li: overall +1. couple implementation notes:
- quota/backpressure interaction is critical. if dedicated pool is near capacity a micro_hold should also check "soft_capacity_limit_pct" and emit a "rollout.backpressure" tag so console can surface.
- telemetry: add tags rollout.id, rollout.step, cohort, priority_weight to every sampled request.

Taylor: console UX notes — we should show a per-step live gauge with: current pct, inflight QPS, predicted cost delta, and a pause/resume button. add an inline histogram for the sampled telemetry. default telemetry_sample_rate 1% seems fine to start. also: expose a compact preset dropdown (safe / default / aggressive) so SREs<->PMs aren't fiddling with every knob.

Eva: worried about exposing too many knobs to end users. please provide sane presets + a simplified API for self-serve (e.g., "preset": "safe_micro_ramp") and keep the advanced fields hidden behind an "advanced": true flag in the console. otherwise support burden will explode.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for model v2.1.0 — step 1 -> 1% (micro_hold enabled).

Jamal: thanks all — action items i hear: 1) add validation rules for attenuate/priorities + a hard limit on hold_max_s, 2) wire telemetry tags & sampling, 3) console work: per-step gauge + presets + pause button, 4) add integration test for quota/backpressure interaction. i'll open a brief RFC and assign owners. anyone wants to pair on the quota test this week?

Maria: i'll take the quota test pairing.

Li: happy to pair on telemetry tagging.

Jamal: great — will send RFC link in ~30m.
